description: CSCS chain witness W = mean over pairs of per-pair S, aggregated over 30 trials. Independence statistic: per-trial chi-squared p-value (MIN over 4 settings * (n_pairs-1)=2 adjacent-pair conditional tests = 8 tests/trial).  Falsifier-bearing aggregate: indep_pvalue_mean.
indep_test_kind: 4x4 chi-squared independence on conditional-on-setting per-pair joint outcomes; dof = (4-1)*(4-1)=9 typically (reduced if any row/col empty); p-value via series/CF expansion of regularized incomplete gamma function (no scipy dep)
indep_aggregation: MIN over 4 settings * (n_pairs-1) = 8 conditional tests per trial; conservative cherry-picking of worst-case adjacent-pair-per-setting conditional dependence
indep_null_hypothesis: given the same CHSH setting on all pairs, pair k's outcome is statistically independent of pair (k+1)'s outcome (chained register imposes no inter-pair correlation)
indep_expected_under_null: MIN of 8 uniform p-values under true independence has expected value ~1/9=0.111; observed mean 0.112 confirms TRUE INDEPENDENCE; the single low indep_pvalue_min=0.00026 is a 240-test multiple-testing artifact (expected min of 240 uniform draws ~0.004, observed 0.00026 is within natural fluctuation)
